_doc: v0.2.100 WP-03a (AD-1, L2-F10, L3-F02): the error contract of the ONE orchestrator-update command.
Producer: launcher/src-tauri/src/commands/update_failure.rs (its tests execute every row below).
Consumer: the launcher store's routeUpdateError / errorText (WP-08 vitest reads this same file).
Command: invoke('run_orchestrator_update', {kind}) where kind is one of contract.update_kinds.
On failure the command rejects with a STRING that is JSON: {kind, message, ...payload}.
message is never empty and never starts with contract.forbidden_message_prefix; the frontend renders it ONCE, unprefixed.
Payload kinds flatten their payload into the top level and keep the legacy modal field names, including 'event'.
On success the command resolves with contract.outcome_example's shape.
